title: Global Sea Surface Currents and Temperature
description: Sea surface current flows from the ECCO2 project (MIT/JPL; MITgcm synthesizing satellite and in-situ data), coloured by corresponding sea surface temperature. NASA's colour bar: Sea Surface Temp (°C), 0 to 32, linear.

files.role: display: the map and the globe texture
analysed: the temperature scale is read from this colour bar
analysed: every temperature and note is computed from these pixels
files.method: Decoded once with macOS sips 316 and resampled to 1024 × 512, stored as PNG with only IHDR/IDAT/IEND so browsers and tests read identical pixels

retrievalNote: svs.gsfc.nasa.gov timed out from this network, so the files were retrieved from the Internet Archive's raw captures of NASA's original URLs. Re-verify the hashes against NASA's live files when reachable.

credits.model: ECCO2: Estimating the Circulation and Climate of the Ocean, Phase II (MIT/JPL), MITgcm

limits: Model temperatures as rendered, read back from colour (about 1 °C precision); one moment, 19 June 2007; traces show where currents flow, not their speed.
